claims: As of January 23, 2025, Micheál Martin is the Taoiseach (Prime Minister) of Ireland.
Micheál Martin is the leader of the Fianna Fáil party.
Micheál Martin held the office of Taoiseach from 2020 to 2022.
Micheál Martin currently leads the government following an agreement between Fianna Fáil, Fine Gael, and independent TDs.
The Taoiseach is the head of government of Ireland.
The Taoiseach is appointed by the President after nomination by the Dáil Éireann.
Dáil Éireann is the Irish Parliament.
As of March 2026, Micheál Martin has been conducting official duties.
Micheál Martin's official duties include the traditional St. Patrick's Day visit to Washington, D.C.
The office of Taoiseach was established by the 1937 Constitution of Ireland.
The office of Taoiseach replaced the previous title of President of the Executive Council.
